command:
docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U brain -d brain -X -A -t -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c 'WITH candidate AS (SELECT 1::smallint AS identity_version, '\''SLOT'\''::text AS slot_role,
'\''test:foo@v1'\''::text AS predicate_key, '\''registry/1'\''::text AS predicate_release_ref,
'\''SINGLE'\''::text AS cardinality, NULL::uuid AS object_entity_id,
NULL::uuid AS parent_slot_id, NULL::text AS member_key,
1::smallint AS fingerprint_version, NULL::text AS identity_fingerprint,
'\''11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111'\''::uuid AS created_by,
'\''test:foo@v1'\''::text AS slot_type), evaluated AS (SELECT (
  (identity_version IS NULL AND slot_role IS NULL AND predicate_key IS NULL
     AND predicate_release_ref IS NULL AND cardinality IS NULL AND object_entity_id IS NULL
     AND parent_slot_id IS NULL AND member_key IS NULL AND fingerprint_version IS NULL
     AND identity_fingerprint IS NULL AND created_by IS NULL)
  OR (identity_version = 1 AND fingerprint_version = 1 AND created_by IS NOT NULL
     AND identity_fingerprint ~ '\''^[0-9a-f]{64}$'\''
     AND predicate_key ~ '\''^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,63}@v[1-9][0-9]{0,3}$'\''
     AND length(predicate_release_ref) > 0 AND slot_type = predicate_key
     AND cardinality IN ('\''SINGLE'\'','\''MULTI'\'','\''RELATIONSHIP'\'')
     AND ((slot_role = '\''SLOT'\'' AND parent_slot_id IS NULL AND member_key IS NULL
            AND ((cardinality = '\''RELATIONSHIP'\'') = (object_entity_id IS NOT NULL)))
       OR (slot_role = '\''MEMBER'\'' AND cardinality = '\''MULTI'\'' AND parent_slot_id IS NOT NULL
            AND length(member_key) > 0 AND object_entity_id IS NULL)))) AS check_result FROM candidate) SELECT check_result IS NULL AS check_returns_unknown, check_result IS NOT FALSE AS postgres_check_accepts FROM evaluated;'
sql:
WITH candidate AS (SELECT 1::smallint AS identity_version, 'SLOT'::text AS slot_role,
'test:foo@v1'::text AS predicate_key, 'registry/1'::text AS predicate_release_ref,
'SINGLE'::text AS cardinality, NULL::uuid AS object_entity_id,
NULL::uuid AS parent_slot_id, NULL::text AS member_key,
1::smallint AS fingerprint_version, NULL::text AS identity_fingerprint,
'11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111'::uuid AS created_by,
'test:foo@v1'::text AS slot_type), evaluated AS (SELECT (
  (identity_version IS NULL AND slot_role IS NULL AND predicate_key IS NULL
     AND predicate_release_ref IS NULL AND cardinality IS NULL AND object_entity_id IS NULL
     AND parent_slot_id IS NULL AND member_key IS NULL AND fingerprint_version IS NULL
     AND identity_fingerprint IS NULL AND created_by IS NULL)
  OR (identity_version = 1 AND fingerprint_version = 1 AND created_by IS NOT NULL
     AND identity_fingerprint ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
     AND predicate_key ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,63}@v[1-9][0-9]{0,3}$'
     AND length(predicate_release_ref) > 0 AND slot_type = predicate_key
     AND cardinality IN ('SINGLE','MULTI','RELATIONSHIP')
     AND ((slot_role = 'SLOT' AND parent_slot_id IS NULL AND member_key IS NULL
            AND ((cardinality = 'RELATIONSHIP') = (object_entity_id IS NOT NULL)))
       OR (slot_role = 'MEMBER' AND cardinality = 'MULTI' AND parent_slot_id IS NOT NULL
            AND length(member_key) > 0 AND object_entity_id IS NULL)))) AS check_result FROM candidate) SELECT check_result IS NULL AS check_returns_unknown, check_result IS NOT FALSE AS postgres_check_accepts FROM evaluated;
